name: Glenrowan Solar Farm
current_developer: Glenrowan Solar Farm Pty Ltd as trustee for Glenrowan Solar Farm Trust
notable: 41 MW solar farm near Glenrowan, VIC. Developed by RES Group.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Victorian Ministerial Permit PA2101420 – Glenrowan Solar Farm (with 2026 BESS permit PA2302185)
eis_specs.notes: 130 MWdc / 102 MWac solar farm on ~245 ha adjacent to Glenrowan Terminal Station (separate from the earlier Glenrowan West and Winton projects, which also connect at Glenrowan TS). WSP engineering. Connection works permit PA2101420 (2023) covers grid tie-in; co-located BESS permit PA2302185 approved 28 May 2026. Panel/inverter OEMs not disclosed in Victorian ministerial permit register.
